headline: Execution to pick-up in H2; large order pipeline supports long-term growth

highlights: x ICICI Securities – Retail Equity Research Data Patterns (DATPAT) CMP: ₹ 4025 Target ₹ 4920 (22%) Target Period: 12 months November 10, 2026 Execution to pick-up in H2; large order pipeline supports long-term growth… About the stock : Data Patterns (India) (DPIL) is a vertically integrated defence and aerospace electronics solutions provider.

Customers include MoD, DRDO, DPSUs, private sector players and exports • Company’s order backlog stands at ₹ 2,698 crore as of Sep’26 Investment Rationale: • Strong order inflows and growing order visibility support near - term revenue growth: The company secured fresh orders worth ₹1,046 crore during H1FY27, taking its order book to ₹2,698 crore (3.5x TTM evenue) as of Sep-26 including negotiated orders.
Management also indicated an additional order pipeline of ₹1,500-2,000 crore, with opportunities across HAL, radar, electronic warfare and other defence programmes.
Management believes that developing complete products in-house will enable direct participation in larger MoD programmes, increase value addition and reduce dependence on ToT through defence PSUs.
